data.one_liner: Provides offline SQLite persistence for Stream Chat in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Stores chat data locally using Drift (SQLite) and syncs it with the Stream Chat backend. Enables offline access, optimistic UI updates, and faster reads by caching messages, members, reactions, and more.
use_when: You need offline chat support with caching and sync for Stream Chat apps
You want faster local reads and optimistic UI updates
Your app targets multiple platforms including web, requiring a unified storage solution
avoid_when: Your app doesn't use Stream Chat or needs a generic storage solution
You prefer a NoSQL or key‑value store over SQLite
You want a zero‑dependency solution for tiny apps
strengths: Full offline cache for all chat entities
Built on Drift with indices for performance
Works across mobile, desktop, and web (with sql.js)
weaknesses: Adds SQLite dependency and native setup
Web requires manual inclusion of sql-wasm files
Only useful with Stream Chat, not a general storage library
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec, run flutter pub get, and for web include sql-wasm.js and sql-wasm.wasm in the web folder
data.minimal_example:
final chatPersistentClient = StreamChatPersistenceClient(logLevel: Level.INFO, connectionMode: ConnectionMode.regular);
final client = StreamChatClient(apiKey, logLevel: Level.INFO)..chatPersistenceClient = chatPersistentClient;
